That first `"beta gamma"` starts at character 6 and has length 10, so the quote spans offsets 6 through 16. The function appends one new `MessageEntity` for each original entity whose range overlaps that span and whose trimmed overlap length is positive.

From the test’s constructed entities, the valid UTF-16-adjusted entities come from candidate spans `(6,10)`, `(2,16)`, `(6,10)`, `(8,7)`, `(11,4)`, `(5,12)`, `(20,8)`, `(0,5)`, and `(53,4)`. Of these, the first six overlap the quote range `[6,16]`, while `(20,8)`, `(0,5)`, and `(53,4)` do not. Therefore the loop appends 6 entities, so `entities` has size 6 at return.

{"entities":6}
